about.subtitle: Data Science · Data Analytics · Full-Stack Development
about.p1: A Data Science and Full-Stack graduate who finds clarity in complexity, with a deep interest in Japanese culture, ethics, and technology.
about.p2: Specialising in Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, and Full-Stack Development. My stack spans Python, Pandas, and XGBoost for ML — Node.js, React, and SQL for web and data applications — and Power BI for data visualisation.
about.p3: When I'm not training models, I'm likely practicing badminton, studying Japanese, or reading about ethical AI. Currently building end-to-end ML pipelines that go from raw data to deployed inference.

tech.p1: Specialising in Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, and Full-Stack Development. My stack spans Python, Pandas, and XGBoost for ML — Node.js, React, and SQL for full-stack applications — and Power BI for data visualisation.
tech.p2: From building ML forecasting pipelines on Japan Tourism Agency data to developing full-stack web applications and data dashboards, I work across the full data lifecycle — raw data to deployed inference. Interested in Data Analyst, AI/ML, and Full-Stack opportunities in Japan.
